name: Haus Helga
beschreibung: Ferienhaus Helga is situated in a quiet, sunny location in Tirol, with views of the surrounding mountains. The rooms are traditionally furnished and offer modern comfort. A well-equipped kitchen is available for self-catering. In the surrounding area, hiking and cycling trails invite you to explore. In winter, several ski areas are quickly reachable. The cozy atmosphere of the house creates a relaxed holiday mood.
